effects.description: (2 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(3 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Adds 4-200 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage to an enemy within 10 meters of you with a Heavy Attack causes you to throw a cone of knives, dealing |cffffff816|r Physical Damage to enemies hit. If an enemy hit has |cffffff50|r% Health or less, they also take an additional |cffffff1631|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff14|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff15|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
